content:
anya (CSE): quick sync on ArgoHealth caching + batching numbers for this week — short thread with highlights and next steps.
metrics-bot: daily report: hit_rate=38.4% avg_batch=2.9 cost_per_1k_tokens=$0.52 latency_p50=95ms error_rate=0.7%
anya (CSE): thanks — flagging that hit rate slipped again after last config change. seeing more short sessions.
sophie (Acct Mgr): renewal conversation next week — want to show progress on cost improvements. any quick wins we can present? :eyes:
troy (Solutions): short answer: yes. we can show a simulated savings slide if we tune prefetch TTL and bump batching threshold. rough calc: +12pp hit rate -> ~22% cost reduction on text gen.
mike (Eng): digging into logs — most misses are due to user prompts exceeding 256 tokens, so prefix cache isn't firing. also a bunch of single-message chat flows causing batch size=1.
anya (CSE): can we safely increase KV cache window to 384 without degrading tail latency?
mike (Eng): tentative yes. ran A/B on one tenant: latency_p95 +12ms, p50 unchanged. hit_rate up 11.3pp. full rollout needs canary + rollback flag.
metrics-bot: canary snapshot: tenant=argohealth canary_hit_rate=49.7% canary_avg_batch=3.4 canary_cost_per_1k=$0.38
troy (Solutions): nice. prep slide: current vs canary numbers side-by-side. I'll draft a 1-slide ROI: current hit 38.4% -> canary 49.7% ; cost_per_1k $0.52 -> $0.38 ; est monthly savings ~$12k for their volume.
sophie (Acct Mgr): perfect — that'll help renewal. i'll book a 20-min prep with ArgoHealth on Tue.
anya (CSE): action items: 1) eng: schedule canary rollout to 50% (mike) 2) solutions: create ROI slide + short notes for CS (troy) 3) acct: schedule renewal prep (sophie) 4) CSE: collect 3 customer QA prompts where cache missed (anya)
mike (Eng): noted — will open rollout PR and enable feature-flagged TTL=384, throttled-canary=50%. PR: #4281. ETA: EOD Wed.
troy (Solutions): I'll post draft slide in #customer-success by Mon EOD.
anya (CSE): one quick data ask: can metrics-bot export top-5 prompt lengths for missed cache cases (csv) so we can craft enablement doc?
metrics-bot: export queued — will post in thread once ready (expected ~10m).
sophie (Acct Mgr): thanks all. keep thread lean, will forward to exec brief after ROI slide is ready. :thumbsup:
anya (CSE): closing note — if canary numbers hold, expected cost_per_1k target <$0.40 and hit_rate ~50%+. we'll reuse the same plan for two other high-volume tenants next month.
mike (Eng): FYI, also toggling batching_threshold from 20ms->10ms for chat route to capture small bursts. should bump avg_batch ~0.3. monitoring dashboard updated.
anya (CSE): great — see you next sync.
